native-fixture.boundary: Temporary directories and local JSON/equality helpers; no subprocess is started by nativeLab.

operator-local.boundary: Injected Command returns synthetic records/errors. Operator and HostSession inspect/curate them; Note also writes events.json, but assigned assertions inspect in-memory Events rather than its persisted bytes.

diagnostic-file.boundary: CaptureHostStatus receives synthetic failing command result, writes a curated JSON snapshot through writeJSON, and the test reads the actual file through readObject. No operator subprocess is run.

process-runtime.boundary: Start/Execute use exec.Cmd with process groups; Exited uses waitid without reaping; Stop signals groups, reads /proc until quiescent, waits/reaps, and closes output. Hooks are explicitly identified per root.

process-fixture.boundary: fixtureProcess is synthetic PID1234 with group/signal/exited/wait/quiescent/reap hooks. A root using it does not thereby establish kernel process behavior.

owned-socket-file.boundary: CleanupOwnedSockets refuses any nonnil Process sentinel; otherwise os.Remove unlinks each owned path and attempts the empty directory. Test paths are regular files, not Unix sockets.

lease-parser.boundary: Synthetic journal JSON strings pass through local slog parsing and timestamp/hash/epoch filters. journalctl/SSH are not invoked.

managed-fixture.boundary: Creates actual temporary directories and empty VM/mount maps; this alone does not establish a network or VM boundary.

managed-commands.boundary: RunCommand delegates injected commands or uses actual runBoundedCommand; the latter opens capture file, starts subprocess, observes/waits/stops it and retains pending ownership on failure.

managed-network.boundary: Network checks command-fed address/route JSON and records link ownership before dispatch. Tests inject all ip calls; no actual link creation occurs.

managed-cleanup.boundary: Cleanup preserves resources while commands remain pending and retries Stop; after quiescence it removes actual rootfs/fixture files. Link probes/deletions are injected in assigned roots; no VM/RustFS is started.

managed-credential-stage.boundary: Production reads credentials through direct file descriptors, dispatches Install, then invokes sha256sum and cmp through Command. Test install hook copies/mutates actual files; non-install commands delegate Execute without sudo.

managed-manifest-access.boundary: LoadManagedManifest reads actual manifest/input bytes, pins direct regular files, then unix.Access(X_OK) rejects current-user execution access. This assigned root returns during common-input validation; later member material is not reached.

managed-vm-start.boundary: Start creates serial/vmm capture files and calls exec.Cmd.Start on missing executable. Failure calls finishCapture, closes and clears capture pointers. Test Resource hook returns nil, and no Firecracker or Unix API is reached. Subsequent Stop uses the local nil-Process branch.

managed-volume-text.boundary: ManagedVolumeSetupScript substitutes configured runtime-directory strings in constant shell templates. The test only inspects returned text; mount/blkid/chown commands are not executed.

const managedVolumeSetupScriptA = `#!/bin/sh
set -eu
DEVICE=/dev/vdb
ALIAS=/dev/oracleoci/oraclevdb
MOUNT=__MANAGED_MEMBER_DIR__/volume
UUID=76f1b43d-7d79-4f41-9a6e-cc1f4aaab102
attempt=0
while [ "$attempt" -lt 120 ]; do
  if [ -b "$DEVICE" ] && [ -e "/dev/disk/by-uuid/$UUID" ] &&
     [ "$(readlink -f "/dev/disk/by-uuid/$UUID")" = "$DEVICE" ]; then break; fi
  attempt=$((attempt + 1)); sleep 0.5
done
[ "$attempt" -lt 120 ] || exit 1
[ "$(/usr/sbin/blkid -s UUID -o value "$DEVICE")" = "$UUID" ] || exit 1
for directory in /srv/ts-managed __MANAGED_MEMBER_DIR__ __MANAGED_MEMBER_DIR__/material __MANAGED_MEMBER_DIR__/control "$MOUNT"; do
  [ ! -L "$directory" ] && [ -d "$directory" ] || exit 1
done
[ ! -e /dev/oracleoci ] || [ -d /dev/oracleoci ] || exit 1
mkdir -p /dev/oracleoci
[ ! -e "$ALIAS" ] && [ ! -L "$ALIAS" ] || exit 1
ln -s ../vdb "$ALIAS"
if findmnt -rn -S "$DEVICE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || mountpoint -q "$MOUNT"; then exit 1; fi
mount -t ext4 -o rw "$ALIAS" "$MOUNT"
[ "$(findmnt -n -o TARGET --source "$DEVICE")" = "$MOUNT" ] || exit 1
[ "$(findmnt -n -o FSTYPE --target "$MOUNT")" = ext4 ] || exit 1
chown 0:65534 "$MOUNT"; chmod 0750 "$MOUNT"
[ ! -e "$MOUNT/.terrascale-member-claim" ] || exit 1
mkdir -m 0700 "$MOUNT/data" "$MOUNT/replication"
chown 65534:65534 "$MOUNT/data" "$MOUNT/replication"
`

native-provenance.boundary: CaptureNativeProvenance and VerifyExecutable hash /proc/self/exe and read embedded build info. NewManagedLab reads/hashes actual module/source inputs using DirectDigest; no Go command is invoked.

prepare-base.boundary: runPrepareBase resolves/hashes real input files, creates disposable output/staging directories, copies/stages file bytes and modes, validates account files and publishes known-hosts. Command and uid are injected: mount, ssh-keygen, systemd-sysusers and systemctl are synthetic; pending process uses hooks. Local command-option/argv assertions coexist with actual file readback.

production-audit-local.boundary: productionAuditFixture builds synthetic OCI request maps; CheckProductionAudit iterates maps and predicates, with no simulator/network/cloud request.

qualification_limits: SOURCE_ONLY_CANDIDATE; no acceptance ledger or count promotion.
No deletion, retirement or completion authorization; all safety obligations retained.
File/process evidence qualifies only the exact stated actual boundary; synthetic networking, ext4 mounts, Firecracker, SSH crypto, systemd and OCI/S3 are not qualified.
